name: Kopia

lifecycle.note: The v2 recipe prepares separate private UI and repository passwords for the official 0.23.1 server. Shared setup verifies Basic-auth UI access and the current-user response only. Its --async-repo-connect flag lets HTTP start while repository opening retries indefinitely; login does not prove a connected repository. No repository or snapshot-source storage is mounted. Full backup setup still requires owner-selected durable storage, credentials, mounts and source paths, plus replay-safe repository creation/connection. Isolated restore remains a separate acceptance gate.

security: Protect repository password, server credentials, and retention policy.
pitfalls: The generated repository password does not create or connect a repository; keep it available for an owner-approved repository setup.
Kopia does not issue an API key during this server-password bootstrap. The saved admin password only verifies private UI access, not backup readiness.
The current Compose recipe has no repository or snapshot-source mount. A local filesystem repository would live on the same host and would not satisfy the off-host-repository dependency by itself.
Repository availability, snapshot sources, and isolated restore must be tested independently.
